Name: Cypher's Seasonal Greenhouse - (CP) and (AT)
Author: Genomecypher
Description:
I am slowly working to create a complete set of all farm buildings and this is the greenhouse to match my base barns and coops and SVE premium barn and coop retexture mods.

The greenhouse has a couple of options that can be configured using Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). You can select whether or not the greenhouse has a fence and whether you want a more simple fence or a slightly more complex one (simple vs full). I'm also not a fan of the heavy building shadows in the base game so an added a more minimal shadow so it's not as heavy but also matches the other farm buildings. There is an option to use the original base game shadows.

I like the greenhouse entry sometimes, depending on what pathing I am using but sometimes I just want it gone, so I highly recommend using bblueberry's awesome Green House Entry Begone if you aren't already using it. 

Update:
Alternative Textures version added! Unrepaired greenhouse may appear to repeat but that is because it shares the same image files as the repaired greenhouse which has a different image file for each season, fence type, and shadow choice. 

Hope you enjoy!
